note: V1 of the weather plan (06.10.2026): the climate along the coast, the average the game's simulated weather varies around. Changing this file starts .github/workflows/klima.yml. 15 years and not the 30 of a normal period: Open-Meteo counts a long request as many calls, and 19 points over 30 years would pass its daily limit. Bodø, Tromsø and Kirkenes moved out to sea for klima-2: in klima-1 their ERA5 cells were mostly land, with winters far colder than on the coast. H1b R5 (04.11.2026): 13 points out in the sea fields of the new frame (Bjørnøya to Shetland, at sea beside the islands); fetch.py keeps the points src/data/climate.json already has and fetches only the new ones, and a month under the ice, where the marine API has no sea temperature, gets the freezing point of sea water (-1.8 °C).
